title: The Song Sheet with Two Sides
youtube_title: The Song Sheet with Two Sides | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A smaller piece, fairly given, can still be enough.
summary: At a bakery counter on a soft, busy morning, Uma sees that a song sheet printed on both sides will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Uma makes a smaller, even share so Tove is included, and Ms. Okonkwo lets the choice stand without a speech.
